method: pre-V0 empirical scan — READ real code before asserting any target/hook
summary: All reuse hooks named in the architecture spec exist. The PL1 premise (games store is write-only in src/) is CONFIRMED. PGN export does NOT exist anywhere (greenfield affordance). No STOP condition.

reuse_hooks.note: Writes a GameRecord to the 'games' store. Called from src/ui/Play.svelte:450 (the ONLY runtime caller).

NO read of the 'games' store exists in gamesRepo.ts. getAnalysis(gameId) reads gameAnalyses, putImportedGame writes importedGames. F5 ADDS getAllGames() here — the natural home (file already centralises games/importedGames/gameAnalyses access).

interface TrainerDB: games: { key: string; value: GameRecord; indexes: { playedAt: number } }. Index physically created in the v1 upgrade block. getAllFromIndex('games','playedAt') is available WITHOUT a DB_VERSION bump or new index.
Has pgn (export source), playedAt (sort/index), result, botElo, variant (960 flag → exclude from analyse-affordance per existing AP-960-4). id format 'g:<epoch>' (Play) — distinct from analysis ids.
Import.svelte already uses parsePgn + inferPlayerColor with full edge-case handling (multi-game split, headers-only guard, color-not-detected guard). F5 REUSES this exact flow — no new parser.

RunAnalysisInput.source accepts 'imported' | 'played'. Persists gameAnalyses keyed by gameId, generates puzzles, folds weaknessCounters. Idempotent re-run is handled at the CALLER via getAnalysis(gameId) (Play.svelte:461-466 short-circuits if an analysis exists). runAnalysis itself does NOT pre-check; it overwrites — caller owns idempotency.

Returns GameAnalysis | undefined. A history list maps each game id → analysed (defined) / not (undefined). NOTE: Play game ids are 'g:<epoch>'; gameAnalyses is keyed by gameId, so getAnalysis('g:<epoch>') is the correct lookup for a played game.
Shared result panel (props: analysis, puzzlesMade). Already consumed by Import.svelte:186 AND Play.svelte:640. A history 'open analysis' affordance can reuse it verbatim.

Owns the single-game paste → parsePgn → runAnalysis(source:'imported') flow + persists ImportedGameRecord. Reachable via nav key 'nav.analyse' (view 'import') and Home 'home.analyseGame'. NATURAL host for a games-history section (Q-A default).
Has gameId, playerColor, analyzedAt. Confirms the analysed/not marker keys on gameId.

pgn_export_state.evidence: grep for createObjectURL|Blob(|download=|.download|saveAs|a.click() across src/**/*.{ts,svelte} → NO matches. No download/export affordance anywhere in the app.
pgn_export_state.implication: PGN export is a greenfield client-side affordance. GameRecord.pgn already holds a chess.js-serialised PGN (game.pgn() at Play.svelte:433) — export is a download wrapper over an existing string, no re-serialisation needed.
